scope: Candidate 1.2.0 supports schema annotations in element/attribute item-type aliases and supported structural sequence types, including node-name unions, nested documents, arrays and record fields. The annotation resolves independently against in-scope schema types and retains declaration namespaces under prefix rebinding; item-type aliases are not substituted into the schema annotation. Built-in and imported simple/complex schema types are accepted. Unknown annotations raise XPST0008; undeclared annotation prefixes raise XPST0081; malformed or empty annotations raise XPST0003. Only element annotations permit the nillable ? marker. The ##any default maps unprefixed schema annotations to the XML Schema namespace. Twenty-eight new regressions cover matching untyped and validated nodes, non-coercion, imported simple/complex types, nillability, namespace identity, nested contracts and unused declarations. fn/named-parameter function grammar, schema-element/schema-attribute alias traversal, document shorthand and package exposure remain follow-ups. N04/N05 and REQ-126 remain In Progress. Published version stays 1.1.3; candidate 1.2.0 remains unpublished.
